formRaceEntries.comment: Resumes. Is a first-up winner but last in two jumpouts leading up to this. Awkwardly drawn so check the betting.
Better effort when leading and boxing on here last time. Drops in class & drawn to be in this for a long way.
Got back but closed OK in SA first-up. Is a second-up winner & blinkers go back on for this.
formRaceEntries.gearChanges: Blinkers AGAIN, Cross-over Nose Band OFF FIRST TIME
formRaceEntries.lastGear: Blinkers AGAIN, Cross-over Nose Band OFF FIRST TIME

formRaceEntries.comment: Should have finished closer in this class at Wodonga last time. Back in trip for this & the wetter the better.
formRaceEntries.lastGear: Lugging Bit ON, Nose Roll ON, Tongue Tie OFF

formRaceEntries.comment: Able to run a much improved race for a new stable at Wangaratta. Worth thought despite the awkward draw.
Always wide last start but game in the placings at two previous outings. Worth another chance dropping in class.
Never likely on debut for the stable at Mildura. Drops in class but others have stronger claims.
formRaceEntries.gearChanges: Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only) AGAIN, Tongue Tie AGAIN
formRaceEntries.lastGear: Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only) AGAIN, Tongue Tie AGAIN

formRaceEntries.comment: This looks too tough.
Better effort when having a good run here last time. Drops in class but draw makes the task tougher.
Had every chance & stuck on OK on debut for the stable here last time. Rough place hopes look best from the draw.
Rose from picnic level last start and failed to fire. Fifth of six in a Cranbourne jumpout since.
Struggled in SA second-up and this looks too hard for him.
formRaceEntries.lastGear: Bandages (Front) ON, Cross-over Nose Band ON, Visors OFF

formRaceEntries.comment: Has not shown enough this campaign to include in chances.
formRaceEntries.lastGear: Compression Hood With Ear Muffs OFF, Ear Muffs (Pre-Race Only) ON

formRaceEntries.comment: Freshened after a terrible effort at Werribee. Back in trip & looking elsewhere for the winner.
formRaceEntries.lastGear: Blinkers OFF, Cross-over Nose Band OFF, Tongue Tie OFF

formRaceEntries.comment: Only battling of late. Hard to see him making the required improvement.
Struggled in a harder race at Bendigo but well held in this class two runs back. Others preferred.
Second in a Bendigo jumput since another disappointing run last start. Hard to enthuse.
Well beaten in both runs this time in. Cannot consider her here.
Two runs for this stable have been full of merit and a win looks close despite the draw.
Has faded from on pace at two runs since an improved showing at Naracoorte. Needs that form.
